now.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
now.text: Selvig helps Thor reach the Water of Sights.

proposed.text: Selvig helps Thor reach the Water of Sight.

changes.evidence: On screen Selvig says 'So, this is it. The Water of Sight.' The plural 'Water of Sights' comes only from a tie-in book (The Cosmic Quest), and the record's own 'at' already uses 'The Water of Sight'.

now.title: X-Men: First Class
now.text: Erik breaks her out, and she joins his Brotherhood.

proposed.text: Erik breaks her out, and she joins his band of mutants.

changes.evidence: X-Men: First Class never says the name 'Brotherhood' on screen. In the closing prison scene Erik just says 'Join us' and 'I prefer Magneto' (the transcript has no 'brotherhood'). The name is first spoken in X-Men: The Last Stand ('Welcome to the Brotherhood'). Per the brief, a name the screen never uses should not be kept. The file's team is already 'Erik's Mutants'.

now.title: Venom
now.text: Anne loses her job and breaks up with Eddie after he exposes the Life Foundation. She briefly bonds with Venom to free Eddie from Carlton Drake.

proposed.text: Anne loses her job and breaks up with Eddie after he confronts Carlton Drake with her confidential files. She briefly bonds with Venom to free Eddie from Drake's men.

changes.evidence: Eddie does not expose the Life Foundation. He confronts Drake about the human trials using a classified document he took from Anne, and that gets them both fired. Later Drake's men capture Eddie (Drake is not there), and Anne bonds with Venom to free him.
